applies_when: the current evidence does not attribute the critical-path delay to one observed layer
cards.mechanism: The current evidence does not locate delay at one execution layer.
cards.distinguishing_question: Which observed lane owns the critical-path delay, and which layers were not observed?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Capture one bounded cross-layer timeline before selecting a layer-specific mechanism.

required_evidence: an identity-bound timeline with explicit layer coverage and analysis-window boundaries
positive_signals: one layer accounts for an observed critical-path interval
counter_signals: coverage is missing or overlapping lanes prevent attribution
invalidators: timeline window is boundary ambiguous

applies_when: repeated CPU runtime or framework intervals precede short GPU kernels in the same identity-bound window
cards.mechanism: CPU submission, synchronization or graph breaks leave gaps between short GPU kernels.
cards.distinguishing_question: Do CPU launch or sync intervals explain GPU gaps after profiler overhead is excluded?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Check operator, graph-break, and launch attribution before requesting a broader system trace.

required_evidence: CPU runtime or operator events correlated with the affected GPU intervals
a stable workload shape and profiler identity
positive_signals: repeated CPU-side gaps precede short kernels
graph or compile breaks align with gaps
counter_signals: GPU kernels occupy the critical path
gaps disappear without instrumentation
invalidators: trace lacks CPU runtime events
workload shape distribution changed

applies_when: an identity-stable GPU kernel occupies enough observed critical-path time to clear the local minimum-effect floor
cards.mechanism: The observed access pattern may require more global-memory transactions than the useful bytes demand.
cards.distinguishing_question: Do generated addresses and transaction accounting show amplification beyond useful bytes?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Inspect generated code and static resources before paying for counter replay.

required_evidence: identity-bound transaction accounting
generated addresses or access widths for the same kernel
positive_signals: transaction count is amplified relative to useful requested bytes
counter_signals: transactions match the aligned useful-byte lower bound
invalidators: kernel identity changed or the access path is unmodeled

applies_when: GPU idle intervals align with input preparation, data loading, or host queue work
cards.mechanism: Input preparation or queueing prevents representative work from reaching the GPU.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does a bounded preloaded-input intervention remove the idle interval without changing inference work?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Attribute host input work and the corresponding GPU idle interval in one bounded trace.

required_evidence: host input or queue intervals correlated with GPU idle time
unchanged representative input shapes and request distribution
positive_signals: preloaded input removes the same GPU idle interval
counter_signals: idle persists with input preparation bypassed
invalidators: preloaded inputs change shape or request distribution

applies_when: host-device copy intervals are correlated with the workload and overlap is absent or incomplete
cards.mechanism: Host-device copies serialize with compute or move more bytes than the workload requires.
cards.distinguishing_question: What share of the critical path is attributable to copies, and is overlap actually possible?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Measure copy, runtime, and synchronization intervals in the same contained timeline slice.

required_evidence: copy intervals with byte counts and correlation identifiers
critical-path overlap accounting
positive_signals: copy intervals serialize with the hot path and byte counts match the input
counter_signals: copies overlap compute or are outside the critical path
invalidators: copy and kernel correlation IDs are unavailable

applies_when: a collective or rank-arrival interval lies on the observed distributed critical path
cards.mechanism: Collective duration, rank imbalance or missing overlap limits the distributed critical path.
cards.distinguishing_question: Do per-rank traces show the same collective delay and the same arrival skew?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Compare aligned rank arrival, collective, and upstream intervals before changing communication.

required_evidence: aligned per-rank collective and arrival intervals
stable rank, topology, and workload identities
positive_signals: collective is on the critical path across ranks
counter_signals: one rank arrives late because of upstream compute
invalidators: rank clocks or trace windows are not aligned

applies_when: endpoint latency remains outside accounted GPU and preprocessing intervals
cards.mechanism: Request handling, serialization, storage or host state dominates latency outside GPU work.
cards.distinguishing_question: Which bounded request-path interval remains after GPU and preprocessing time are removed?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Bound the request-path interval while retaining GPU and host-runtime correlation.

required_evidence: request-path and host-runtime intervals in the same workload window
an unchanged request corpus and load regime
positive_signals: component timing explains the endpoint latency gap
counter_signals: request-path time is overlapped or outside the critical path
invalidators: request corpus or load changed between observations

applies_when: identity-bound traffic exceeds the workload byte lower bound or intermediates are materialized off chip
cards.mechanism: Insufficient reuse or intermediate materialization may move the same useful data through DRAM repeatedly.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does a byte-flow lower bound explain less traffic than the measured or generated path?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Account for loads, stores, and materialized intermediates before collecting replay counters.

required_evidence: identity-bound byte-flow lower bound
generated or measured memory traffic for the same path
positive_signals: the path reloads reusable data or writes an avoidable intermediate
counter_signals: observed traffic is consistent with compulsory input and output bytes
invalidators: the workload byte lower bound or kernel identity is unavailable

applies_when: validated stall and scheduler observations indicate memory dependencies leave too few eligible warps
cards.mechanism: Outstanding memory latency may not be covered by independent work or sufficient resident warps.
cards.distinguishing_question: Do scheduler eligibility and dependency stalls remain limiting when bandwidth is not saturated?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Inspect dependency distance and asynchronous movement before requesting focused scheduler counters.

required_evidence: version-mapped scheduler and stall semantics
generated dependency path for the same kernel
positive_signals: memory-dependency stalls coincide with low scheduler eligibility
counter_signals: bandwidth or synchronization explains the same stalled interval
invalidators: the profiler version has no verified stall-semantic mapping

applies_when: static resources or spills limit residency for the exact generated kernel
cards.mechanism: Register allocation, local-memory spills, or shared-memory use may constrain useful residency.
cards.distinguishing_question: Which exact static resource constrains residency, and does the critical path require more residency?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Read exact registers, spills, and shared-memory use from the generated artifact before replay.

required_evidence: generated-artifact resource accounting
exact architecture and kernel identity
positive_signals: one static resource or spilling constrains residency on the observed path
counter_signals: resources permit residency and more occupancy would not cover the observed limiter
invalidators: resource accounting belongs to a different binary or architecture

applies_when: the exact launch shape leaves SMs unused or a partial final wave occupies the critical interval
cards.mechanism: The available work may not distribute evenly enough to keep the device busy through the kernel tail.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does launch geometry account for idle SM capacity after resource limits are included?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Check exact launch metadata and static resource limits before collecting wave metrics.

required_evidence: exact launch geometry
device SM count and generated-kernel resource identity
positive_signals: grid coverage or the final wave leaves observed device capacity idle
counter_signals: the grid supplies enough resident work and another limiter explains utilization
invalidators: launch geometry or exact device identity is unavailable

applies_when: generated instructions and validated pipe observations disagree with the workload precision contract
cards.mechanism: The generated arithmetic path may use a different instruction pipeline or data type than the workload permits and expects.
competing_explanations: precision conversion outside the hot kernel
cards.distinguishing_question: Does the generated instruction and conversion path match the exact precision contract and architecture facts?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Compare generated arithmetic and conversion instructions with the precision contract.

required_evidence: exact precision contract
generated instructions bound to the current architecture and binary
positive_signals: the actual arithmetic or conversion path differs from the permitted target path
counter_signals: generated instructions match the precision contract and observed compute pipe
invalidators: precision requirements or exact architecture capability is unknown

applies_when: validated barrier or atomic observations align with the hot kernel dependency path
cards.mechanism: A synchronization scope or contended atomic update may serialize otherwise parallel work.
cards.distinguishing_question: Which dependency requires the observed barrier or atomic scope, and is contention visible on that path?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Map synchronization and atomic instructions to required dependencies before counter replay.

required_evidence: generated synchronization or atomic instructions
source dependency and correctness scope
positive_signals: the same synchronization or atomic site accounts for validated waiting or contention
counter_signals: the operation is uncontended or required ordering is not on the critical path
invalidators: dependency scope or generated-code identity is unavailable

applies_when: generated code shows the measured NMS output path writes FP32 directly
cards.mechanism: Direct FP32 NMS output stores can remove conversion work from the critical kernel path.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does generated code isolate the FP32 output-store change on the measured NMS path?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Compare the generated output-store path before requesting counter replay.

required_evidence: identity-bound NMS timing
generated-code evidence for the FP32 store path
positive_signals: the FP32 output-store mechanism is present in sealed generated-code evidence
counter_signals: the generated output path is unchanged
invalidators: engine or plugin identity changed

applies_when: generated code shows a wider FastSort result-store path in the measured NMS kernel
cards.mechanism: A wider FastSort store path can reduce output traffic in the measured NMS kernel.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does generated code isolate a wider FastSort store path?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Check the store instructions before requesting profiler replay.

required_evidence: identity-bound FastSort NMS timing
generated-code evidence for the store path
positive_signals: the wider FastSort store path is present in sealed generated-code evidence
counter_signals: the generated store path is unchanged
invalidators: engine or plugin identity changed

applies_when: generated code shows less reserve-path reduction work in the measured FastSort NMS kernel
cards.mechanism: A smaller group-reserve path can remove reduction work from FastSort NMS.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does generated code isolate the reserve-path reduction change?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Check reduction instructions before running counter replay.

required_evidence: identity-bound FastSort NMS timing
generated-code evidence for the reserve path
positive_signals: the smaller group-reserve mechanism is present in sealed generated-code evidence
counter_signals: the generated reduction path is unchanged
invalidators: engine or plugin identity changed

applies_when: a candidate runtime trace shows actual cross-stream GPU overlap
cards.mechanism: TensorRT auxiliary streams can overlap independent GPU work on the critical path.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does a candidate trace show cross-stream overlap that reduces the complete measured path?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: A correlated CUDA timeline is required to distinguish real overlap from extra event work.

required_evidence: baseline and candidate timelines
paired complete-path timing
positive_signals: cross-stream overlap is present in a sealed candidate trace
counter_signals: overlap is absent or outside the critical path
invalidators: trace windows or engine identities differ

applies_when: generated code shows persistent counter state on the measured NMS path
cards.mechanism: Persistent counters can replace repeated transient counter traffic in NMS.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does the persistent-counter path clear the configured complete-path effect floor?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Verify the counter-state code path before any profiler replay.

required_evidence: generated-code evidence
paired complete-path timing against the local threshold
positive_signals: persistent-counter code is present in sealed generated-code evidence
counter_signals: the code path is absent or the measured benefit is below threshold
invalidators: engine or plugin identity changed

applies_when: generated code shows the common FastSort-to-Map path is fused
cards.mechanism: Fusing FastSort and Map can remove a launch, but only if the fused span clears the local effect floor.
cards.distinguishing_question: Does the fused common path reduce complete-path time by at least the configured minimum effect?

cheapest_falsifier.rationale: Confirm the fused code path before requesting a timing or profiler gate.

required_evidence: generated-code evidence
paired complete-path timing against the local threshold
positive_signals: the fused FastSort-to-Map path is present in sealed generated-code evidence
counter_signals: the fused path is absent or slower than the baseline
invalidators: engine or plugin identity changed
